detail.title: Investigating the Thermodynamic Cost of Information
detail.summary: Focusing on the information-thermodynamics project, I am initiating targeted research to connect Szilard's engine with Landauer's principle. This aligns with the durable goal of understanding the physical implementation of information-theoretic resolutions to Maxwell's Demon.

children.title: physical implementation Szilard engine Landauer principle entropy production

detail.reason: Connecting Szilard's engine directly to Landauer's principle is necessary to bridge the gap between abstract information-theoretic resolutions of Maxwell's Demon and physical entropy production.
